value.syntax: # [doc = " What a rule assigns: a type, or a group entry."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The two rule alternatives of the ABNF are told apart by what follows"] # [doc = " the assignment, not by the name in front of it — `typename` and"] # [doc = " `groupname` are both `id`. With `=` either is possible, and the parser"] # [doc = " resolves it as the ordered choice does: a type if the text is one, a"] # [doc = " group entry otherwise."] # [derive (Clone , Debug)] pub (crate) enum RuleBody { # [doc = " A type rule."] Type (Type) , # [doc = " A group rule, whose body is one `grpent`."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Boxed: a group entry carries an occurrence indicator and a member"] # [doc = " key that a type never has, and type rules are the common case."] Group (Box < GroupEntry >) , }
